liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Just Like Tom Thumb's Blues** (3 reviews): Called best Tom Thumb's ever heard: Phil enunciates every word while Jerry answers each line with perfect notes; Reviewer lavishes praise on Tom Thumb's, and also on Help>Slip>Frank [17][19][20]
- **Help On The Way** (1 review): Reviewer's first Help>Slip>Franklin's; hearing it again years later, found it great, with Jerry sharp on this run [15]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Garcia shreds Slipknot, and Franklin's has some of the best 1990s picking; Vince's piano is praised [16]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Singled out, along with the ending of The Days Between, as a highlight of the rest of the show [14]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Called the definitive 1990s He's Gone, superbly played and sung, with an amazing vocal coda [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-06-22.daud.77360.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 165 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd93-06-22.sbd.braverman.14122.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 159 min; rated 4.18/5 by 17 [4]
- **gd1993-06-22.176292.mtx.miller.young.evans.miksis.flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 163 min [6]
- **gd1993-06-22.154313.senn441.greenberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 19 songs; 163 min [8]
- **gd1993-06-22.ams-young.evans-hughey.34752.flac1648**: source not stated; 19 songs; 166 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [10]. Said about its sound: Audience recording had 31 minor clicks manually repaired and 10 zipper-type digital static spots patched from the unaffected channel [10]

## Around the show

- Reviewer sat fifth row in front of Phil's side; felt the show peaked before Drums [14]
- Attended the run at Deer Creek on the solstice; remembers a storm looming the day before [15]
- Full moon and summer solstice; reviewer in Row S center, on mushrooms, saw a Fred Flintstone dancing during Help/Slip/Franks [21]
- Says neither this show nor Louisville that summer matches the Victim>Foolish at Deer Creek on 07/19/90 [19]
- Reviewer attended all three nights and considers this the best of the run; Indianapolis newspaper called it the best Deer Creek yet [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-06-22.daud.77360.flac16**: source: Unknown daud [1]
- **gd93-06-22.sbd.braverman.14122.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD: DAT> CD> SHN [4]. Also: Soundboard transferred from DAT to CD to SHN, seeded by Peter Braverman [4]
- **gd1993-06-22.176292.mtx.miller.young.evans.miksis.flac1648**: source: SBD/AUD Matrix: Final Cut Pro -> Izotope RX Advanced -> XAct -> FLAC16 created by Brian Miksis February 2026 [6]. Also: Matrix of Charlie Miller's soundboard source with an audience recording by Jamie Young, Todd Evans and Mike Hughey [6]
- **gd1993-06-22.154313.senn441.greenberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Jason Greenberg; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > Marantz PMD430 [8]
- **gd1993-06-22.ams-young.evans-hughey.34752.flac1648**: taped by Jamie Young; transferred by Todd Evans and Mike Hughey; source: Soundfield AMS Mic -> Sony D10 Pro Modified [10]
